name: Basil Pesto
ingredientsText: basil blend (genovese basil d.0.p., sunfluwer oil, sea salt) sunflower oil, parmesan cheese, (pasteurized part-skim cow's milk, cheese cultures, sea salt, enzymes), pine nuts, extra virgin olive oil, pecorino romano d.o.p.cheese (sheep's milk, rennet, salt), fresh garlic, ascorbic acid, citric acid, black pepper.
notes: Sheep's milk and cow's milk both count as milk. Pine nuts are a tree nut.
